source.author: Anastasia Kireeva
source.title: Low-degree hardness of finding the largest clique in Erdős–Rényi graph (problems 36-38)
source.locator: Randomstrasse 101, posted 2026-06-05, first displayed Open Problem 35

methods.name: PROVE SOMETHING WEAKER, COMPLETELY
methods.outcome: Proved a complete restricted source-valid theorem for weak zero-field pairwise Ising nulls with transitive orbit mixtures of extensive linear-field tilts: subexponential orbit-shell overlap pressure plus the prior local-table/Toda transport certificate transfers bounded source LDA at D_n to bounded noised LDA at every fixed fractional degree below D_n.

methods.name: READ THE FAILURES, NOT THE SUCCESSES
methods.outcome: Prior-art reconciliation materially tightened: De Roeck–Schütz provides close quasi-local spectral-flow/KAM machinery; Dobrushin/Kotecký–Preiss are classical. High temperature alone does not make extensive constant-amplitude plants compatible with polylogarithmic source degree; bulk cancellation or an interface theorem is still needed.

methods.name: FIND THE GROUP ACTING
methods.outcome: Derived the exact orbit-shell collision formula and a shell-specific Gaussian-concentration pressure certificate Xi_n = log[M_n^{-1} sum_r v_{n,r} exp(4 C_GCB lambda_n^2 ||a_n+g_r a_n||_2^2)].

prior_art: Xuan Chen and Shuangping Li, arXiv:2608.06279, 2026-08-06
Wojciech De Roeck and Marius Schütz, arXiv:1512.07612
next_obligation: Move beyond weak-amplitude orbit tilts: prove or refute a genuine two-copy interface/bulk-cancellation pressure theorem for constant-amplitude extensive plants, sharpen the pressure-to-output-degree loss, and reconcile the Kato/Toda transport with quasi-local spectral-flow prior art before any novelty claim.
